```{r}
# --- Configuration ---
# Set the path 
input_file <- "/lustre/scratch126/gengen/projects_v2/alpha-allostery-global/allostery_pathogenicity/00.human_proteome_unzipped/AlphaMissense_aa_substitution_nov2025_zenodo.tsv"

# Set the directory where you want the output CSVs to be saved.
output_dir <- "/lustre/scratch126/gengen/projects_v2/alpha-allostery-global/allostery_pathogenicity/00.human_proteome_unzipped/all_AM"

# 2. Read the TSV file
# Use fread() for fast reading. It automatically handles the separator (tab in TSV).
# The 'skip' argument is used to skip the initial two comment lines starting with '#'
cat("Reading the input file...\n")

data <- fread(
  input_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  skip = 2 # Skip the initial comment/copyright lines
)

# 3. Clean up column names (optional but recommended)
# This removes potential leading/trailing whitespace from column headers
setnames(data, trimws(names(data)))

head(data)

# 4. Split the data by 'uniprot_id' and write to individual CSV files
cat("Splitting data and writing CSV files...\n")

# data.table approach: Use the by= argument to group and then iterate
data[,
  # j expression (This is the only argument between the commas)
  {
    protein_id <- .BY$uniprot_id
    output_filename <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(protein_id, ".csv"))

    # .SD is automatically the data subset for the current group
    fwrite(.SD, file = output_filename, quote = FALSE)

    cat(paste0("Written: ", output_filename, "\n"))
  },
  by = uniprot_id # <--- Correctly placed as the 'by' argument
]

head(data)
```

am_path <- "/lustre/scratch126/gengen/projects_v2/alpha-allostery-global/allostery_pathogenicity/00.human_proteome_unzipped/all_AM"

# Output directory for results
output_dir <- "/lustre/scratch126/gengen/projects_v2/alpha-allostery-global/allostery_pathogenicity/00.human_proteome_unzipped/results_unzipped/AM_results/lm_rds"
#dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Define a small value epsilon
epsilon <- 1e-10

# Function to process each protein
process_protein <- function(protein_id, ddg_path, am_path, output_dir) {
  # File paths
  ddg_file <- file.path(ddg_path, paste0("ThermoMPNN_inference_AF-", protein_id, "-F1-model_v4.csv"))
  am_file <- file.path(am_path, paste0(protein_id, ".csv"))
  
  # Skip if files are missing
  if (!file.exists(ddg_file) || !file.exists(am_file)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Read data
  test_ddg <- fread(ddg_file)
  test_am <- fread(am_file)
  colnames(test_am)[1] <- "variant"
  colnames(test_am)[2] <- "AM"  # Rename second column to AM
  
  # Clamp AM scores and compute logits
  test_am[, AM_clamped := pmin(pmax(AM, epsilon), 1 - epsilon)]
  test_am[, AM_logit := log(AM_clamped / (1 - AM_clamped))]
  
  # Adjust position and create variant for merging
  test_ddg[, new_position := position + 1]
  test_ddg[, variant := paste0(wildtype, new_position, mutation)]
  
  # Merge ddG and AM data
  test_df <- merge(test_ddg, test_am, by = "variant")
  test_df[, wt_aa := substr(variant, 1, 1)]
  
  
  # Transform and merge
  test_ddg[, new_position := position + 1]
  test_ddg[, variant := paste0(wildtype, new_position, mutation)]
  test_df <- merge(test_ddg, test_am, by = "variant")
  
  
  # Skip if no data after merging
  if (nrow(test_df) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  ### Linear Model (LM)
  lm_fit <- tryCatch({
    lm(AM_logit ~ ddG_pred, data = test_df)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("LM failed for protein: ", protein_id, " - ", e$message)
    NULL
  })
  
  if (!is.null(lm_fit)) {
    # Add predictions to the data frame
    test_df[, predicted_AM_lm := predict(lm_fit, newdata = test_df)]
    
    # Save LM results
    lm_results <- list(
      fit = lm_fit,
      r_squared = summary(lm_fit)$r.squared,
      adjusted_r_squared = summary(lm_fit)$adj.r.squared,
      predicted_data = test_df[, .(variant, new_position,  ddG_pred, AM, AM_logit, predicted_AM_lm, pdb)]
    )
    saveRDS(lm_results, file = file.path(output_dir, paste0(protein_id, "_lm.rds")))
  }
  
  # Return a summary of the results
  return(list(
    protein_id = protein_id, 
    lm_success = !is.null(lm_fit)
  ))
}

# List RDS files
rds_files <- list.files(path = output_dir, pattern = "_lm.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
length(rds_files) #20139

# Parallel function
extract_r_squared <- function(file) {
  protein_id <- sub("_lm.rds$", "", basename(file))
  adj_r2 <- tryCatch({
    lm_rds <- readRDS(file)
    lm_rds$adjusted_r_squared
  }, error = function(e) {
    NA_real_  # Return numeric NA
  })
  data.table(protein_id = protein_id, adj_r2 = adj_r2)
}

# Run in parallel
all_var_r2 <- rbindlist(future_lapply(rds_files, extract_r_squared), fill = TRUE)

# Result
nrow(all_var_r2)  # 20139
head(all_var_r2)
tail(all_var_r2)

sum(!is.na(all_var_r2$adj_r2))  #20139

# Save the results to a CSV
